primarySources.title: NVIDIA Corp. Form 8-K (Item 5.02 & 9.01: CEO Resignation, Interim CEO & Board Chair Appointment)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. On November 11, 2026, Jen-Hsun (Jensen) Huang notified the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation that he was resigning from his positions as President, Chief Executive Officer and a member of the Board, effective immediately. Mr. Huang's resignation was not the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company's operations, policies or practices. On November 11, 2026, the Board appointed Colette M. Kress, age 59, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of the Company since September 2013, to serve in the additional role of Interim Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately, while the Board conducts a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer. On November 11, 2026, the Board also appointed Harvey C. Jones, age 73, a director of the Company since 1993, to serve as Chair of the Board, effective immediately.

primarySources.title: NVIDIA Corp. Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 Press Release (CEO Transition & Nov 17 1:20 p.m. PT Q3 FY27 Results Schedule)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: SANTA CLARA, Calif., November 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately. Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. The Board of Directors appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair of the Board. Mr. Jones has been an entrepreneur, technology executive, and active venture investor for over 30 years, including serving as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Synopsys. NVIDIA will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on Tuesday, November 17, at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT, as previously scheduled, followed by its earnings call at 2 p.m. PT.

primarySources.title: Anthropic, PBC Form S-1/A Amendment No. 2 (Reg. No. 333-299633; 825M Class A IPO & $26.0B Class N Concurrent Private Placement)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: Anthropic, PBC is offering 801,351,354 shares of its Class A common stock and the selling stockholders are offering 23,648,646 shares of Class A common stock (825,000,000 shares total) at an estimated initial public offering price between $70.00 and $78.00 per share ($74.00 midpoint). Concurrent Private Placement: Contingent upon the completion of this offering and receipt of requisite stockholder approval, we have entered into agreements to issue and sell an aggregate of $26.0 billion of shares of our non-voting Class N common stock at the IPO price ($74.00 midpoint), consisting of approximately $10.0 billion (135,135,135 shares) to NVIDIA Corporation, approximately $10.0 billion (135,135,135 shares) to Google LLC, approximately $2.5 billion (33,783,783 shares) to Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., approximately $1.0 billion (13,513,513 shares) to Microsoft Corporation, $1.0 billion to Broadcom Inc., $1.0 billion to Micron Technology, Inc., and $0.5 billion to TSMC Partners, Ltd. Compute Commitments: Under SpaceXAI Arrangements (May-Oct 2026), we agreed to spend up to $120.5 billion into 2029 for compute powered by NVIDIA GPUs. Under Lambda Agreements (May-Aug 2026), we agreed to spend approximately $41.3 billion into 2034 for NVIDIA GPU compute, of which $34.9 billion is currently terminable following a missed facility-lease milestone. Strategic Partnership with NVIDIA provides access to Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin GPU systems and hardware co-design collaboration. Executed leases that have not yet commenced as of September 30, 2026 totaled $451.2 billion on an undiscounted basis.
